clips.title: The story
paras: For Honor is a quest dedicated to commemorating fallen warriors so their deeds are not forgotten. By completing the task, an adventurer ensures that the sacrifices of these combatants endure in memory.

The quest For Honor is a solemn mission centered on memorializing fallen combatants. In a world continuously tested by conflict, ensuring that soldiers who gave everything are not forgotten stands as a vital duty for those who survive them.

Upon fulfilling the task, the quest giver confirms that the fallen fighters will endure in memory thanks to your efforts. The completed deed ensures their sacrifices remain recognized and respected rather than fading into obscurity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.
Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you done what I asked?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These warriors will always be remembered, friend. You have made sure of that.
